probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, __wherein said electronics module is disposed entirely within said hollow columnar body and said plurality of light emitting diodes are disposed on an exterior surface of said columnar body.__

2. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __to an interior of said hollow columnar body opposite said base member__.

3. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, __said optic element being disposed between adjacent fins__.

4. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material __for converting light emitted by said diodes__.

5. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body, __with at least one diode on each face of the columnar body__.

6. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes, __one fin residing on each corner of said columnar body__.

7. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section, __each face of said cross-section being substantially straight__.

8. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body, __on an exterior surface thereof__.

9. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body, __each fin extending radially from the respective corner__.

10. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __between adjacent fins__.

11. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, __and are integrally formed as a one-piece extrusion__.

12. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 including a single optic element __that__ is disposed between each adjacent fin over-lapping said diode.

13. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base, __and closes said first end of said columnar body__.

14. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current, __said printed circuit board being disposed within said hollow columnar body__.

15. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body, __through a light-transmitting region between adjacent fins__.

16. (Currently amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline, __wherein said electronics module is disposed entirely within said elongated hollow polygonal body.__

17. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode, __wherein said extruding forms a plurality of integral radially extending fins on said elongated hollow body.__

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK, __and said elongated hollow body is aluminum__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins, __said fins being formed during said extruding__.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim [[20]] __17__ wherein said body has substantially straight side walls.
